QF.id: Retirement Planning Products: National Pension System (NPS)_88

question.text: Per the first part of NISM Series XVII workbook p. 144 (which states that employer contribution under 80CCD(2) is allowed up to 14% of Basic + DA for Central Government employees under the new tax regime), which sections are available to Ramesh — a Central Government employee opting for the new tax regime?

answer.text: 80CCD(2) only, up to 14% of Basic + DA
No NPS deductions under new regime

explanation.text: The Logic: Anchored to the first part of NISM Series XVII workbook p. 144, only Section 80CCD(2) survives under the new tax regime, and it allows the employer contribution deduction up to 14% of Basic + DA for Central Government employees. 80CCD(1) and 80CCD(1B) are not available under the new regime. The Trap: Option D is the defensible answer if a candidate relies on the later sentence on the same page, which states that under the new regime employee deduction and 80CCD(2) deduction have been disallowed — an internal contradiction the audit flagged. Options A and B incorrectly retain 80CCD(1) / 80CCD(1B) under the new regime. Note: Workbook p. 144 is internally inconsistent: the earlier text says 80CCD(2) is allowed up to 14% under the new regime, while later text says 80CCD(2) is disallowed under the new regime. The stem has been anchored to the earlier, more specific statement (which other workbook pages echo), making option C uniquely supportable. Candidates should verify against current Finance Act text before applying in practice.
